observations: Photo 0: overhead view of a red gas cylinder with the black protective collar/carry handle open, showing a central valve-hole but no valve or regulator fitted or visible.
Photo 0 and 1: other cylinders in the background (a grey cylinder, a yellow cylinder marked 'BUTANE 13KG') but these are not the item being sold, only context.
Photo 1: close-up of the same red cylinder's neck, black collar heavily scraped, red paint flaking, some metal fitting visible but partly obscured, no legible capacity or brand markings.
No manufacturer name, capacity (kg), or safety/test-date stamp is legible on the red cylinder in either photo.
Cylinder body shows surface rust and worn paint at the neck/collar junction.

claims.claim: We have different gas cylinder for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show only one cylinder in focus; no listing of sizes or types confirmed by image.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity (kg) unknown, which is the main price-setting factor for gas cylinders
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped capacity marking (e.g. '12.5KG', '6KG') usually near the neck or on the collar
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this; treat as unknown capacity

risks.risk: No valve or regulator visible in the neck opening (photo 0 shows an empty hole)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve assembly screwed into the neck, or confirmation it is sold valve-less
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/not functional, missing valve

risks.risk: Visible rust and paint loss at the neck collar could indicate corrosion or structural weakness
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rusted area and any seam/weld points
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and structurally compromised

risks.risk: LPG cylinders require periodic safety/test certification (stamped date); unknown if current or expired
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped manufacture/test date near the neck
risks.if_unproven: priced as expired/uncertified until shown otherwise

proof_requests: Photo of the capacity/kg marking stamped on the cylinder neck or collar
Close-up of the valve or confirmation that a valve/regulator is included
Photo of the manufacture/test date stamp
A side view showing the full body without obstruction to check for dents or deep rust
response.reason: The cylinder's capacity, which sets its price category, is not legible in either photo, and it is unclear whether a valve is fitted, so even a worst-case price cannot be assigned without these missing shots.
